# GitHub Repo Metadata

Configure these in repo Settings on github.com after pushing. Not auto-applied by git.

## Description (350 char limit; ~120 char visible in cards)

```
Run Claude Code from a USB drive on Windows and macOS. Portable Anthropic CLI, zero install, no admin rights, no traces left on host. For developers, travel, and IT troubleshooting.
```

## Social preview image

Upload a 1280×640 PNG at Settings → Social preview. This is what
Twitter, Reddit, Hacker News, Discord, and Slack render when the
repo URL is shared. Auto-generated cards are generic and hurt CTR.

Suggested content for the social card:
- "Claude Code Portable" wordmark
- Subtitle: "Run the real Anthropic CLI from a USB drive"
- Small Windows + macOS icons
- Logo or favicon-sized Claude reference

Save as `docs/social-card.png` and upload via the repo settings UI.

## Promotion checklist (in priority order)

1. Submit a PR to [awesome-claude-code](https://github.com/hesreallyhim/awesome-claude-code)
   adding this repo under the "Tooling" or "Developer Tooling" section
   in `THE_RESOURCES_TABLE.csv`. Highest-authority backlink in the niche.
2. Show HN post titled along the lines of "Show HN: Claude Code Portable
   — run Anthropic's CLI from a USB drive on Windows and macOS".
3. Reddit r/ClaudeAI and r/ClaudeCode self-posts linking the repo with
   the quickstart copy from the README.
4. Dev.to or Hashnode crosspost with `canonical_url` pointing at the
   GitHub README so search authority accrues to the repo, not the blog.
5. Short YouTube walkthrough (3 min) with the repo URL in description.
   Competitor projects rank for "how to" queries via video.
